rationale: Original guideline pp35 and 76 list lentils for fibre and weight management. No boiled-lentil insomnia endpoint is attached to the guidance.
Combined legumes and nuts intake associated with better sleep quality in an adult cross-sectional sample. The exposure and outcome do not isolate boiled lentils or Parkinson insomnia.
GA25 uses saffron in a hematoxylin-eosin-saffron histology stain. The laboratory marker gives no measure of executive function.
GA70 uses canola oil in an artificial vascular phantom. The experiment concerns imaging and supplies no clinically measured anxiety outcome.
Original guideline pp35 and 76 names lentils in dietary plans. It does not specify canned lentils or measure daytime sleepiness.
Combined legumes and nuts intake associated with lower odds of poor sleep and short sleep. The abstract does not give canned-lentil exposure or Epworth results.
Whole-pattern diet scores associated with lower Epworth-defined excessive daytime sleepiness in the prodromal feature study. Diet groups do not identify canned lentils as the exposure.
GA70 uses canola oil in an artificial vascular phantom. The reported modeling supplies no organism, pain response or cold-pressed food comparison.
